#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ==============================================================================
# AI-SoC VMware Twin Full-Stack Build & Config-Driven Deployment Script (TWIN-43)
# Supports: --config, --mode sim|hardware, --uart, --baud, --port,
#           --build-only, --status, --stop, --help
# ==============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SOC_AP_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
DEFAULT_CONF="${SOC_AP_DIR}/config/runtime/vmware/aisoc_twin.conf"

# Default configuration values (overridden by config file, then CLI args)
AISOC_MODE="hardware"
AISOC_UART_DEVICE="/dev/ttyUSB0"
AISOC_UART_BAUD="921600"
AISOC_HTTP_PORT="8080"
AISOC_WEB_ROOT="browser_hmi/first_release"
AISOC_LOG_DIR="/tmp/aisoc_twin_logs"
AISOC_AUTO_BUILD="1"

CONFIG_PATH="${DEFAULT_CONF}"
EXPLICIT_CONFIG=0
CLI_MODE=""
CLI_UART=""
CLI_BAUD=""
CLI_PORT=""
DO_BUILD_ONLY=0
DO_STATUS=0
DO_STOP=0

print_usage() {
    cat <<EOF
Usage: $0 [options]

Options:
  --config <path>         Path to configuration file (default: config/runtime/vmware/aisoc_twin.conf)
  --mode <sim|hardware>   Launch mode: 'sim' or 'hardware' (overrides config)
  --uart <device>         UART device path for AP<->MC link (overrides config)
  --baud <rate>           UART baud rate, default 921600 (overrides config)
  --port <port>           HTTP/SSE gateway listen port (overrides config)
  --build-only            Incrementally build full stack (runtime, forward, device_manager, ui_gateway, host) and exit
  --status                Show running status of all stack daemons and probe HTTP health
  --stop                  Gracefully stop all managed stack daemons and clean up PID files
  --help, -h              Show this help message
EOF
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --config)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --config requires a file path argument" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CONFIG_PATH="$2"
            EXPLICIT_CONFIG=1
            shift 2
            ;;
        --mode)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --mode requires <sim|hardware>" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CLI_MODE="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --uart)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --uart requires a device path" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CLI_UART="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --baud)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --baud requires a baud rate" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CLI_BAUD="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --port)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --port requires a port number" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CLI_PORT="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --build-only)
            DO_BUILD_ONLY=1
            shift
            ;;
        --status)
            DO_STATUS=1
            shift
            ;;
        --stop)
            DO_STOP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --help|-h)
            print_usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            echo "ERROR: Unknown argument '$1'" >&2
            print_usage >&2
            exit 2
            ;;
    esac
done

# Load configuration file
if [[ -f "${CONFIG_PATH}" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    source "${CONFIG_PATH}"
elif [[ "${EXPLICIT_CONFIG}" -eq 1 ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Specified configuration file not found: ${CONFIG_PATH}" >&2
    exit 2
fi

# Apply CLI overrides (highest priority)
if [[ -n "${CLI_MODE}" ]]; then
    AISOC_MODE="${CLI_MODE}"
fi
if [[ -n "${CLI_UART}" ]]; then
    AISOC_UART_DEVICE="${CLI_UART}"
fi
if [[ -n "${CLI_BAUD}" ]]; then
    AISOC_UART_BAUD="${CLI_BAUD}"
fi
if [[ -n "${CLI_PORT}" ]]; then
    AISOC_HTTP_PORT="${CLI_PORT}"
fi

validate_baud_rate() {
    local baud="$1"
    case "${baud}" in
        9600|19200|38400|57600|115200|230400|460800|921600)
            return 0
            ;;
        *)
            echo "ERROR: Unsupported baud rate '${baud}'. Allowed values: 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 115200, 230400, 460800, 921600" >&2
            return 1
            ;;

is_pid_running() {
    local pid_file="$1"
    if [[ -f "${pid_file}" ]]; then
        local pid
        pid="$(cat "${pid_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "${pid}"
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

stop_one_pidfile() {
    local name="$1"
    local pid_file="$2"
    if [[ ! -f "${pid_file}" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    local pid
    pid="$(cat "${pid_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[STOP] Stopping ${name} (PID: ${pid})..."
        kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
        local waited=0
        while kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null && [[ "${waited}" -lt 25 ]]; do
            sleep 0.1
            waited=$((waited + 1))
        done
        if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    rm -f "${pid_file}"
}

stop_services_internal() {

run_status() {
    local log_dir="${AISOC_LOG_DIR}"
    if [[ -f "${log_dir}/runtime.env" ]]; then
        # shellcheck disable=SC1090
        source "${log_dir}/runtime.env"
    fi
    local port="${ACTIVE_PORT:-${AISOC_HTTP_PORT}}"
    local mode="${ACTIVE_MODE:-${AISOC_MODE}}"
    local uart="${ACTIVE_UART:-${AISOC_UART_DEVICE}}"
    local baud="${ACTIVE_BAUD:-${AISOC_UART_BAUD}}"

    local all_ok=1
    echo "================================================================="
    echo "AI-SoC VMware Twin Full-Stack Status (Mode: ${mode})"
    echo "  UART Device: ${uart} @ ${baud} baud"
    echo "  HTTP Listen: 0.0.0.0:${port}"
    echo "================================================================="

    for item in "dbus-daemon:dbus.pid" "forward_service_daemon:forward.pid" "device_manager_daemon:device_manager.pid" "ui-gateway:ui_gateway.pid"; do
        local name="${item%%:*}"
        local pfile="${log_dir}/${item##*:}"
        local pid=""
        if pid="$(is_pid_running "${pfile}")"; then
            echo "  [RUNNING] ${name} (PID: ${pid})"
        else
            echo "  [STOPPED] ${name}"
            all_ok=0
        fi
    done

    local http_code="000"
    http_code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/v1/state" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")"
    if [[ "${http_code}" != "200" ]]; then
        http_code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/v1/temperature/snapshot" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")"
    fi

    if [[ "${http_code}" == "200" ]]; then
        echo "  [HEALTH ] HTTP Probe http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/v1/state -> HTTP 200 OK"
    else
        echo "  [HEALTH ] HTTP Probe http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/v1/state -> FAILED (HTTP ${http_code})"
        all_ok=0
    fi
    echo "================================================================="

    if [[ "${all_ok}" -eq 1 ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}
